name: Indian Omelet
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: Finely-chopped hot green chiles, to taste

steps: In a small bowl, whisk the eggs lightly. Add in all the other ingredients and mix properly.
Set a skillet on stove, and smear its surface with a thin coat of oil.
Pour the contents of the bowl into the skillet.
Turn over and lightly brown other side.

culture.text: The Indian omelet is called so since it has various Indian spices and vegetables added to it.
